providers.name: ChatGPT / Codex
providers.help: 浏览器授权，或导入本机 Codex 登录。实际型号以账号模型列表为准。
providers.helpEn: Authorize in your browser or import local Codex credentials. Discover models available to your account.

providers.name: Claude
providers.help: 先运行 claude auth login，再导入本机 Claude Code 登录。
providers.helpEn: Run claude auth login, then import your local Claude Code login.

providers.name: Grok / Grok Build
providers.help: 使用 xAI 账号浏览器授权，需账号具备相应服务权限。
providers.helpEn: Browser authorization with your xAI account; requires access to the service.

providers.name: Google Antigravity
providers.help: Google 浏览器授权；套餐、区域及模型权限由上游决定。
providers.helpEn: Google browser authorization. Availability depends on upstream plan, region and model access.

providers.name: Qwen Code
providers.help: 设备码登录 Qwen。可用型号取决于账号，允许手动指定。
providers.helpEn: Sign in to Qwen using a device code. Models depend on your account and can be edited.

providers.name: Agnes AI
providers.help: 浏览器授权 Agnes Code；需上游账号和服务可用。
providers.helpEn: Authorize Agnes Code in your browser; requires an active upstream account and service.

providers.name: Command Code Go
providers.help: 先使用 commandcode CLI 登录，再导入 ~/.commandcode/auth.json 中的登录凭证。
providers.helpEn: Sign in with the commandcode CLI, then import the login credentials from ~/.commandcode/auth.json.

providers.name: Qoder
providers.help: 使用 Qoder 订阅账号的 Access Token 与 User ID，也可导入 QODER_ACCESS_TOKEN 和 QODER_USER_ID。会话通过 COSY 签名直连。
providers.helpEn: Use your Qoder subscription account access token and user ID, or import QODER_ACCESS_TOKEN and QODER_USER_ID. Conversations use signed COSY requests directly.
